code='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    def line_indices(lines):
        found = []
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            counts = Counter(x for x in line if x != 0)
            if counts and max(counts.values()) > len(line) / 2:
                found.append(i)
        return found

    def retain(length, lines):
        selected = set(lines)
        start = 0
        for i in lines:
            if start < i:
                selected.add(start)
            start = i + 1
        if start < length:
            selected.add(start)
        return sorted(selected)

    rows = line_indices(grid)
    cols = line_indices(list(zip(*grid)))
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in retain(len(grid[0]), cols)] for r in retain(len(grid), rows)]
'''
